##Pulling Data & Imagery


```{r ALL data pull, message = FALSE}
# Read soil points and pivot to long format
soil_points <- st_read("../Local Data- DO NOT PUSH/fixed_soil_points2.shp") %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c("CID", "SPID"), names_to = "type", values_to = "ID")

# Read AESL data and merge by sample ID
AESL_csv <- read.csv("../Local Data- DO NOT PUSH/Perry_all_samples_all(in).csv")
soil_points <- left_join(soil_points, AESL_csv, by = "ID")

# Write merged sample data to CSV
write_csv(soil_points, "../Local Data- DO NOT PUSH/soil_points.csv")

# --- 2. Define Analysis Extent (Buffered Border) ---

border <- vect("../Local Data- DO NOT PUSH/Border/border_17N.shp")
border_ext <- ext(border)
buffer <- 100  # buffer distance in map units (e.g., meters)
expanded_ext <- ext(
  xmin(border_ext) - buffer,
  xmax(border_ext) + buffer,
  ymin(border_ext) - buffer,
  ymax(border_ext) + buffer
)

# --- 3. Read and Prepare Rasters ---

# Helper function: project, set extent, and resample to template
prep_raster <- function(r, template, crs, ext) {
  r_proj <- project(r, crs)
  ext(r_proj) <- ext
  resample(r_proj, template)
}

# Read template raster (DEM_50)
DEM_50 <- rast("../Data/DEM50_rasters/Elevation_50cm.tif")
DEM_50 <- project(DEM_50, "EPSG:32617")
ext(DEM_50) <- expanded_ext
template <- DEM_50

# Read and prep additional rasters
DEM_25_files <- list.files("../Data/DEM25m_rasters/", pattern = "\\.tif$", full.names = TRUE)
DEM_25 <- rast(DEM_25_files)

topos_50cm_files <- list.files("../Data/DEM50_rasters/", pattern = "\\.tif$", full.names = TRUE)
topos_50cm <- rast(topos_50cm_files)
# Assign unique informative names using file stems
names(topos_50cm) <- make.unique(tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(topos_50cm_files)))

PCA_SR    <- rast("../Local Data- DO NOT PUSH/PCA_SR.tif")
NDVI      <- rast("../Local Data- DO NOT PUSH/NDVI.tif")

# Standardize rasters
DEM_25_prepped    <- prep_raster(DEM_25, template, "EPSG:32617", expanded_ext)
topos_50cm$Geomorphons_50cm <- as.factor(topos_50cm$Geomorphons_50cm)
Geomorphons_50cm_prepped <- topos_50cm$Geomorphons_50cm %>%
    project(DEM_50, method = "near") %>%
    resample(DEM_50, method = "near") %>%
    as.factor()
topos_50cm_prepped <- prep_raster(topos_50cm, template, "EPSG:32617", expanded_ext)
topos_50cm_prepped$Geomorphons_50cm <- Geomorphons_50cm_prepped
names(topos_50cm_prepped) <- names(topos_50cm) # Ensure names are retained after prepping

PCA_SR_prepped    <- prep_raster(PCA_SR, template, "EPSG:32617", expanded_ext)
NDVI_prepped      <- prep_raster(NDVI, template, "EPSG:32617", expanded_ext)

# --- 4. Stack Covariate Rasters ---

DEM_50_stack <- c(template, DEM_25_prepped, PCA_SR_prepped, NDVI_prepped, topos_50cm_prepped)

# Check for duplicate names and stop if found
if(any(duplicated(names(DEM_50_stack)))) stop("Layer names in DEM_50_stack are not unique!")

# (Optional) print names for debugging
print(names(DEM_50_stack))

terra::writeRaster(DEM_50_stack, "../Output/DEM_50_stack.tif", overwrite = TRUE)
```


```{r correlation , message=FALSE}


# --- 1. Split by Data Type ---
soil_points_SP <- filter(soil_points, type == "SPID")
soil_points_C  <- filter(soil_points, type == "CID")

# --- 2. Convert to vect objects ---
soil_points_vect_SP <- vect(soil_points_SP)
soil_points_vect_C  <- vect(soil_points_C)

# --- 3. Extract Raster Values at Sample Points ---
extract_raster_values <- function(points_vect, raster) {
  result <- terra::extract(raster, points_vect, bind = TRUE, xy = TRUE)
  as.data.frame(result)
}

soils_df_SP <- extract_raster_values(soil_points_vect_SP, DEM_50)
soils_df_C  <- extract_raster_values(soil_points_vect_C, DEM_50)

# --- 4. Select Soil Property Columns ---
soil_property_cols <- c('LBC.1', 'LBCeq', 'pH.2', 'Ca', 'K', 'Mg', 'Mn', 'P', 'Zn')

soil_df_cols_SP <- select(soils_df_SP, all_of(soil_property_cols))
soil_df_cols_C  <- select(soils_df_C, all_of(soil_property_cols))

# --- 5. Exclude Non-Essential Columns (first 9 columns) ---
soils_df_wrang_SP <- soils_df_SP[, -(1:9)]
soils_df_wrang_C  <- soils_df_C[, -(1:9)]

```
```{r Correlation Matrix}

# Extract all raster values at point locations
extracted_covariatesSP <- terra::extract(DEM_50_stack, soil_points_vect_SP, bind = TRUE)
extracted_covariatesC <- terra::extract(DEM_50_stack, soil_points_vect_C, bind = TRUE)

# Combine extracted raster values with soil properties
combined_dataSP <- cbind(
  soil_points_singlepoint, 
  extracted_covariatesSP[ , !(names(extracted_covariatesSP) %in% c("ID"))]
)
combined_dataC <- cbind(
  soil_points_composite,   # <-- FIXED: use composite points for C
  extracted_covariatesC[ , !(names(extracted_covariatesC) %in% c("ID"))]
)
cols_of_interest <- c(
  "LBC.1", "LBCeq", "pH.2", "Ca", "K", "Mg", "Mn", "P", "Zn",  # soil properties
  names(DEM_50_stack)                                           # raster variable names
)
# Ensure columns exist in the combined data
cols_of_interest <- intersect(cols_of_interest, names(combined_dataSP))

# Create correlation matrix (removing rows with NAs)
corr_matrixSP <- combined_dataSP %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  select(all_of(cols_of_interest)) %>%
  filter(complete.cases(.))
  # cor(use = "complete.obs")

#convert to data table bc famd is silly
corr_matrixSP <- corr_matrixSP %>%
  data.table::data.table()

#onehot encode option:
corr_matrixSP_onehot<-corr_matrixSP %>%
  data.table::data.table() %>%
  mltools::one_hot()


#only numeric in corr matrices:
corr_matrixSP_onehot_matrix<-corr_matrixSP_onehot %>%
  cor(use = "complete.obs")

pheatmap(corr_matrixSP_onehot_matrix, 
         cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_cols = FALSE, 
         main = "Single Point: Correlation (Predictors vs Nutrients) Hot-encoded",
         angle_col = 45, display_numbers = TRUE, fontsize_number = 8)


famd_matrixSP<-FactoMineR::FAMD(corr_matrixSP) 

factoextra::fviz_famd_var(famd_matrixSP)

corr_matrixC <- combined_dataC %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  select(all_of(cols_of_interest)) %>%
  cor(use = "complete.obs")

nutrients <- c("LBC.1", "LBCeq", "pH.2", "Ca", "K", "Mg", "Mn", "P", "Zn")
predictors <- setdiff(colnames(corr_matrixSP), nutrients)
sub_corrSP <- corr_matrixSP[predictors, nutrients]
sub_corrC  <- corr_matrixC[predictors, nutrients]



pheatmap(sub_corrSP, 
         cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_cols = FALSE, 
         main = "Single Point: Correlation (Predictors vs Nutrients)",
         angle_col = 45, display_numbers = TRUE, fontsize_number = 8)

pheatmap(sub_corrC, 
         cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_cols = FALSE, 
         main = "Composite: Correlation (Predictors vs Nutrients)",
         angle_col = 45, display_numbers = TRUE, fontsize_number = 8)
```

```{r}
n_bootstrap <- 100
train_frac <- 0.7
nutrients <- c("LBC.1", "LBCeq", "pH.2", "Ca", "K", "Mg", "Mn", "P", "Zn") # Add more as needed

# --- BOOTSTRAP SPLIT FUNCTION ---
bootstrap_split <- function(df, n_bootstrap, train_frac) {
  boot_list <- vector("list", n_bootstrap)
  n <- nrow(df)
  train_n <- floor(n * train_frac)
  for (i in seq_len(n_bootstrap)) {
    set.seed(i)
    idx <- sample(seq_len(n))
    train_idx <- idx[1:train_n]
    test_idx <- idx[(train_n + 1):n]
    boot_list[[i]] <- list(
      train = df[train_idx, , drop=FALSE],
      test  = df[test_idx, , drop=FALSE]
    )
  }
  boot_list
}

# --- MAIN WORKFLOW ---
for (nutrient in nutrients) {
  # For both SP and C datasets
  for (data_name in c("SP", "C")) {
    df <- get(paste0("soils_df_wrang_", data_name)) # expects your dataframes in env
    boot_list <- bootstrap_split(df, n_bootstrap, train_frac)
    for (b in seq_len(n_bootstrap)) {
      train_set <- boot_list[[b]]$train
      test_set  <- boot_list[[b]]$test

      # --- RANDOM FOREST ---
      predictors <- setdiff(names(train_set), c(nutrients, "x", "y"))
      rf_formula <- as.formula(paste(nutrient, "~ ."))
      train_rf <- train_set %>% select(all_of(c(nutrient, predictors)))
      control <- trainControl(method = "cv", number = 10)
      # Skip bootstraps with only one unique value (classification error prevention)
      if (length(unique(train_rf[[nutrient]])) < 2) next
      rf_model <- train(rf_formula, data = train_rf, method = "rf", trControl = control)
      pred_rf <- predict(rf_model, test_set)

      # --- KRIGING ---
      krig_train <- train_set %>% select(all_of(c(nutrient, "x", "y")), everything()) %>% na.omit()
      krig_test  <- test_set  %>% select(all_of(c(nutrient, "x", "y")), everything()) %>% na.omit()
      coordinates(krig_train) <- ~ x + y
      proj4string(krig_train) <- CRS("+proj=utm +zone=17 +datum=NAD83 +units=m +no_defs")
      coordinates(krig_test) <- ~ x + y
      proj4string(krig_test) <- CRS("+proj=utm +zone=17 +datum=NAD83 +units=m +no_defs")
      vgm_model <- variogram(as.formula(paste(nutrient, "~ 1")), data = krig_train)
      fitted_model <- fit.variogram(vgm_model, model = vgm("Sph"))
      krig_pred <- gstat::krige(as.formula(paste(nutrient, "~ 1")), locations = krig_train, newdata = krig_test, model = fitted_model)
      test_set$krig_pred <- krig_pred$var1.pred

      # --- CLASSIFICATION (optional, by nutrient) ---
      if (nutrient == "P") {
        test_set <- test_set %>%
          mutate(rf_class = classify_P(pred_rf),
                 krig_class = classify_P(krig_pred$var1.pred))
      } else if (nutrient == "K") {
        test_set <- test_set %>%
          mutate(rf_class = classify_K(pred_rf),
                 krig_class = classify_K(krig_pred$var1.pred))
      } else if (nutrient == "Mg") {
        test_set <- test_set %>%
          mutate(rf_class = classify_Mg(pred_rf, .data[["pH.2"]]),
                 krig_class = classify_Mg(krig_pred$var1.pred, .data[["pH.2"]]))
      } else if (nutrient == "Zn") {
        test_set <- test_set %>%
          mutate(rf_class = classify_Zn(pred_rf),
                 krig_class = classify_Zn(krig_pred$var1.pred))
      }
      # Save, print, or analyze as needed
      # Example: print(table(test_set$rf_class, test_set$krig_class))
    }
  }
}
```
